extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Understanding maps — map is a flat 2D representation of Earth or part of it. Three types: physical (natural features — mountains brown, rivers blue), political (boundaries of countries/states/cities in different colours), thematic (one theme — rainfall, population, crops). (2) Elements of a map — title (tells what map shows), scale (relationship between map distance and real distance), direction (compass rose — N, S, E, W), legend/key (explains symbols and colours). (3) Globe vs map and atlas — globe: 3D ball, shows true shape, cannot be folded, shows whole Earth at small scale. Map: flat, portable, shows small area in detail, easy to carry. Atlas: collection of maps bound in a book with an index. (4) Physical divisions of India — 6 divisions: Northern Mountains (Himalayas, snow-capped, feed Ganga/Yamuna/Brahmaputra, protect from cold winds), Northern Plains (flat, fertile, formed by alluvium from rivers, good for farming), Peninsular Plateau/Deccan Plateau (oldest landmass, hard rocks, rich in minerals, Narmada/Godavari/Krishna rivers), Coastal Plains (narrow strips along east and west coasts, fishing and ports), Desert (Thar Desert in Rajasthan, sandy and dry), Islands (Andaman and Nicobar in Bay of Bengal, Lakshadweep in Arabian Sea). Misconceptions: 'a physical map and a political map are the same' (physical maps show NATURAL features like mountains and rivers, political maps show BOUNDARIES of countries and states — they show different things), 'the compass rose is just decoration' (the compass rose shows DIRECTION — North, South, East, West — it is essential for reading a map correctly), 'a globe and a map are the same' (a globe is 3D and round, a map is FLAT and portable — a globe shows the whole Earth but cannot be carried easily, a map can be folded and carried), 'the Northern Plains are made of hard rock' (the Northern Plains are made of soft fertile ALLUVIUM deposited by rivers — they are NOT rocky, the Deccan Plateau is the rocky region), 'the Himalayas are in the south of India' (the Himalayas are in the NORTH of India — they form the Northern Mountains division, not the south). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function MapsIndiaGame), NOT export default. Export interface MapsIndiaGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
